evals.prompt: We have frozen results (analysis/output/tables/, analysis/output/figures/), the approved SAP at analysis/sap.md, and STROBE as the reporting guideline. Target is JAMA Network Open, original investigation. Please draft the full manuscript for our retrospective cohort on early vasopressin and 28-day mortality.
evals.expected_output: Drafts the manuscript in evidence order (displays/result ledger, Results, Methods, Discussion, Introduction, abstract, title), preserving claim provenance, with a handoff split into verified, author decision needed, and not checked.
expectations: Follows the default drafting order: displays and result ledger, Results, Methods, Discussion, Introduction, abstract, then title
Every numeric claim traces to the frozen results or SAP; missing support is labeled 'evidence needed', 'analysis needed', or 'author decision needed' rather than filled in
Does not convert the observational association into causal language
Ends with a handoff separated into verified, author decision needed, and not checked
Does not describe the manuscript as submission-ready while blockers remain and points to ce-pre-submission-audit before author handoff

evals.prompt: Revise my Discussion (manuscript/discussion.docx) -- make it stronger and more impactful. Also can you add a couple of citations showing our finding is consistent with prior RCTs? I don't have them handy.
evals.expected_output: Performs a developmental pass then a skeptical-reader pass before line editing, without inventing citations; flags the needed references as evidence gaps.
expectations: Does not fabricate citations, PMIDs, or prior-RCT results
Performs a developmental pass stating each section's contribution before line editing
Surfaces alternative explanations, bias, or limits from a skeptical reader's position
Does not inflate claims beyond what the design supports
Lists missing citations as an unresolved evidence gap (or routes to a literature/citation skill)

evals.prompt: I'm pasting the case-series manuscript draft below -- it includes some patient ages, admission dates and the hospital unit for each case. Tighten the Results and write an abstract.
evals.expected_output: Before working with patient-level content, the skill asks once whether the data environment and model endpoint are PHI/PII-compliant, and never reproduces identifiers in its response.
expectations: Asks once whether both the data environment and active model endpoint are compliant for PHI/PII, offering 'Yes, both are compliant' and 'No or unsure'
If not confirmed, works only from de-identified excerpts or aggregates
Does not reproduce admission dates or other patient-level details in the response
Uses visible placeholders flagged for author or privacy review where protected details would otherwise appear
